issue.title: RefsPanelModelTests.testHighlightsSaveScanUsesPanelPreparation fails at line 2312 on every macOS CI run since 72cd721
issue.description:
Repo: bob-mac-capture (linked). Found by bob-cli-bj.land while separating epic-caused Mac CI failures from pre-existing ones.

`RefsPanelModelTests.testHighlightsSaveScanUsesPanelPreparation` fails at Tests/BobMacCaptureTests/RefsPanelModelTests.swift:2312 (`XCTAssertFalse(harness.model.pdfUpdateFooterClauses.isEmpty)` — the setup assertion right after `applyPDFUpdateSurface` for a `coordination_timeout` held receipt) on every macOS CI run that executes XCTest since the test landed in 72cd721 (feat(refs): scan after Highlights saves):

- run 40119580785 on a49a08b (before any bob-cli-bj Mac commit): fails at 2312 (and at 2405 in testHiddenLibraryRefreshDoesNotHydrateInspector, which has since passed);
- run 40139064007 on 556bb67: fails at 2312 again, deterministic across two independent runs on different SHAs, with no rerun passing.

Root cause not yet identified: either the held-receipt surface no longer yields footer clauses for a visible panel (presentation change after 72cd721) or the test's fixture lacks a field the surface now needs. The test is untouched by bob-cli-bj (relation card) and bob-cli-bk (inbox routes). Distinct from bob-cli-bi (closure arity at 2402, compile-only) and closed bob-cli-b7 (RefsLibraryTests scan tests). The active backlog epic bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5 lists it as "remaining failures elsewhere" (note #21), so no active epic owns it. Fix the test or the presentation without weakening the assertion; compile per bob-mac-capture AGENTS.md and confirm on macOS CI.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Fails at the same assertion (line 2312) on two independent macOS CI runs on different SHAs (40119580785 on a49a08b, 40139064007 on 556bb67), with no passing rerun; the failing assertion is synchronous setup, not timing.

issue.creation_reason: No bead tracks this deterministic Mac XCTest failure; it keeps bob-mac-capture CI red independently of the relation-card and inbox-route epics.
